scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=cybersecurity-champions-frontend
scripts.db:local:init: wrangler d1 execute cybersecurity-champions-db --local --file=../migrations/0001_initial.sql && wrangler d1 execute cybersecurity-champions-db --local --file=../migrations/0002_seed_challenges.sql
scripts.db:local:reset: wrangler d1 execute cybersecurity-champions-db --local --command="DROP TABLE IF EXISTS shares; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS completions; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS leads; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS challenge_translations; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS challenges;" && npm run db:local:init
scripts.db:remote:init: wrangler d1 execute cybersecurity-champions-db --remote --file=../migrations/0001_initial.sql && wrangler d1 execute cybersecurity-champions-db --remote --file=../migrations/0002_seed_challenges.sql
